row:
Hi! I'm Sydney, a veterinary student documenting my journey through vet school one rotation at a time.

On this channel you'll find day-in-the-life vlogs, clinical rotations (ICU, ER, surgery, anesthesia, shelter medicine, and more), study and productivity videos, and advice for pre-vet and veterinary students.

Whether you're curious about what vet school is really like, preparing to apply, or simply love animals and veterinary medicine, I hope my videos educate, inspire, and make you feel like you're right there with me.

Welcome to the journey!
